notes.title: Graphics Update and New Features
notes.notes:
✨ Graphic improvements to the Sealed Gate game! ✨

Hello Amornians! We are pleased to inform you about significant improvements in the graphics of our game. Now it is even more realistic and attractive!

What's new?

- Character Illumination: Your character will now illuminate the area around them, making the game world more vibrant and atmospheric.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/2ce516f01f94d19e5f602542b28fc19a7b4238a8.jpg[/img]

- Time of day color scheme: We have carefully designed the color scheme for each time of day to create a realistic feeling of day, night, morning and evening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/27ce48b524c506505130718bb1eefab8750b8511.jpg[/img]

- Morning and Evening: In addition to the classic Day and Night, the game now has Morning and Evening, adding even more variety to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/4e7f146a61a6bc02a4298384a4479ab4c4e4d94d.jpg[/img]

- Personal Item Lighting: Many items now have their own personal lighting, such as a torch in the player's hand or a candle on the table. This adds visual effects and atmosphere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/3db1ce8ca949bb4f064c5954db553e7161450bef.jpg[/img]

- Clouds: We have added clouds to decorate the sky and create a sense of depth and space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/ab18ea6f6d4a286582e5bdfc1ece12080a05a2aa.jpg[/img]

- Redesigned texture colors: The textures are now less bright, giving the game a more natural and pleasing look.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/23033c3ae5be2d41fe5f65604c38f42ce5c10e77.jpg[/img]

- Rick's updated farm: The starting location has been completely redesigned to make it more interesting and attractive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/509460171b4bb4aede86c05cd33788768e6c6af1.png[/img]

- Illuminated Streets: Streetlights now illuminate the streets, creating a cozy atmosphere and helping players navigate the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/3b12a347ab7a43acb8c166b4ae1ebe45e365b6ea.jpg[/img]

We decided to keep the static lighting for now, but if you think it should be dynamic, let us know! Your feedback is very important to us!

notes.title: Sealed Gate: Development News and Plans for the Near Future
notes.notes:
Hello, Amornians!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/6ca34bf0b6ed4bd6cafc45b70995336fb91ee555.jpg[/img]

We would like to share with you the latest news about the game development. Right now our team is focused on improving the balance of the game. This is one of the most important aspects that affects almost every action in the game world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/a675f3b891926924d8d397763c3db77ae2d41609.jpg[/img]

At the same time, our artists are hard at work creating new locations and characters, while our writers are developing a compelling storyline and exciting quests. We are also adding new non-player characters (NPCs), improving the PvP and PvE systems, and working on the interface to make your adventures even more convenient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/be7a54b8d4df9a4eaeb98a533d5919dae50b0fb0.jpg[/img]

We are eagerly awaiting the release of Sealed Gate into Early Access. This event will take place very soon! Check out the interface now!

notes.title: PlayTest 2 has started!
notes.notes:
Welcome, future adventurers of the Amornian Continent! The first brave players have already set out to explore the history of this wonderful world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/e5179ebc097781f47ac83882b9c5115464618113.png[/img]

The plot of Sealed Gate takes place 30 years after the end of the massive war unleashed by Orpheus. Life on the mainland is beginning to improve, but it seems that his followers have appeared and are determined to finish Orpheus' work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/38184e2a21f22ce4a212664476c27c0f64284944.png[/img]

In Sealed Gate, you can choose your path: explore the history and mysteries of this continent, or choose a profession of your choice and develop in that direction. 
The game emphasizes social interaction, crafting and trading. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/c6c3a64e577f7a2e75e98f48d5c604f3b0885df0.gif[/img]

It's up to you to build, craft, learn, survive and fight for yourself or the future of the Amorian continent. The choice is yours! Choose your destiny!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/732eccd5c6e5da52bf5385069aada42680a9c501.jpg[/img]

Now everyone can leave a request to participate in the PlayTest of the game, evaluate it and help the developers to release Sealed Gate into Early Access as soon as possible. 

We await you, Amornians!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44255842/d2e44ddb9117ef574c9de1e198d2f3af7be26d48.png[/img]
